title: Early lineage divergence segregates sensory and motor-associative identities in the thalamus
title_zh: 早期谱系分化在丘脑中分离感官和运动联合身份
abstract: The thalamus integrates sensory, motor and associative functions through distinct nuclei, yet the developmental principles driving their specification remain unclear. Here we generate a spatiotemporal single-cell multiomic and spatial transcriptomic atlas of the embryonic mouse thalamus, combined with barcoding-based lineage tracing. We identify two major glutamatergic lineages, sensory-related and motor-associative, each governed by different gene regulatory programs and temporal dynamics. These lineages arise from spatially and molecularly distinct progenitor domains, revealing an early segregation of functional identities. Within the sensory lineage, we resolve branching sensory trajectories leading to first-order visual and somatosensory neurons, both emerging from a shared higher-order-like state. Using in silico predictions and in vivo perturbation, we identify Sp9 as a key regulator of visual thalamic fate. Together, our findings define the molecular architecture and developmental trajectories that underpin thalamic modality specification, providing a framework to understand how functional circuits emerge in the mammalian brain. Sensory and motor-associative identities in the thalamus arise from two early-diverging lineages, with sensory neurons progressing through shared intermediate states, revealing how thalamic organization emerges during development.
abstract_zh: 丘脑通过不同的核团整合感官、运动和联合功能，但驱动其规格化的发育原理尚不清楚。本研究通过胚态小鼠丘脑的空间时间单细胞多组学和空间转录组图谱，结合条形码谱系追踪，鉴定出两大主要兴奋性谱系：感官相关和运动联合，每个谱系由不同的基因调控程序和时间动力学控制。这些谱系来源于空间和分子上不同的前体域，揭示了功能身份的早期分离。在感官谱系中，我们解析了通向第一级视觉和体感神经的分支轨迹，它们均源于共享的高级类似状态。利用体内计算预测和体内干扰，我们确定Sp9作为视觉丘脑命运的关键调节因子。总之，我们的研究阐明了支配哺乳动物大脑中功能电路出现的丘脑模式架构和发育轨迹。感官和运动联合身份源于两个早期分化的谱系，感官神经通过共享的中间状态进化，揭示了丘脑组织在发育过程中的形成机制。
